notes.title: Major Update: New Roles and More
notes.content:
Hello Jungle Nation!

This month, we have some exciting new updates including our first gameplay updates that adds new roles to the game. Thank you for your continued support by playing the game and providing feedback. It greatly helps us in making a better game and sharing the great party game experience that we all enjoy with more players!

[b]What's New:
[/b]

[b]- Three New Roles:[/b] Take your games to a whole new level of depth and introduce a new level of mind games and twists to your gameplay.

    - Trustee: a Loyalist who sees two suspects. One of them is the Agent, the other one is the Faker, but it's not clear who's who.
    - Faker: a Leaker who can use this position to trick the Trustee and earn his trust.
    - Mole: the only Leaker that is not seen by the Agent.

[b]- Coin Toss[/b]
Coin toss allows you to leave your vote up to the chances, only once per game. A new fun way to play mind games when voting. Everyone sees the coin toss, so you can use it to blow off some heat by not accepting responsibility about the outcome and feel like a true politician.


[b]- Easy Game Restart[/b]
You can now restart the game with the same players after it's finished, so you don't have to join in again. You will be taken to the lobby where you can immediately start a new game, or change the game config or add/remove players.

[b]- More Tutorial Slides (web app)[/b]
We added more visual slides to our tutorial in the web app (jungle.buzz) to make it easier for you learn and review the rules. We’ll continue to invest more here to make it easy for you invite new friends to your games!

[b]- MacOS Port[/b]
Adding to the Linux support last month, you can now play Republic of Jungle on your MacOS devices too. The Desktop realm is complete! Wait for exciting news about our upcoming platforms...

[b]- Small Bug Fixes[/b]
As usual, you report bugs, we squash them!

Cheers,
Team Gerdoo

notes.title: Republic of Jungle: Update and Pricing Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, Jungle Nation

We hope you've enjoyed sneaking, strategizing, and outsmarting your friends and foes alike in the dense foliage of Republic of Jungle. Our month-long free promotion has come to an end, and we want to thank everyone who joined us on this wild adventure. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been incredibly valuable, and we're excited to announce that Republic of Jungle will now be a paid product on Steam. This transition marks a new chapter for us, and with it, we're rolling out some exciting updates to enhance your gameplay experience.

[b]What's New:[/b]
[b]- Educational Tutorial Slides:[/b] We've launched new tutorial slides available on jungle.buzz. These slides are designed to guide you through the basics and dive into the advanced rules of the game, making it easier for both new recruits and seasoned veterans to thrive in the jungle.

[b]- Linux Port:[/b] By popular demand, we're thrilled to announce that Republic of Jungle is now available on Linux! Dive into the game on your preferred platform. And for our MacOs users, hang tight – your version is on its way soon.

[b]- Enhanced Localization:[/b] We've expanded our localization coverage and implemented fixes to make Republic of Jungle more accessible and enjoyable for players around the globe. Your feedback has been instrumental, and we're committed to continuing these improvements.

[b]- Bug Fixes:[/b] We've squashed some pesky bugs that were lurking in the underbrush. These fixes aim to provide a smoother and more stable gameplay experience for all.

Looking Forward:
As we transition Republic of Jungle to a paid product, we're more committed than ever to supporting our community and delivering an unforgettable gaming experience. These updates are just the beginning – we have plenty more in store for you. 

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who participated in our free promotion. Your support and feedback have been the driving force behind these updates. If you've enjoyed your time in the jungle and want to continue supporting us, consider writing us a positive review on Steam. This would help us a lot!

Stay wild and civil!

- Gerdoo Team

notes.title: Introducing the All New Republic of Jungle
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Jungle Nation! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=iqzS9vWXm_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to be back with an exciting Republic of Jungle dev log. Let's dive into the latest updates we've been working on.

[h2]1. Updated UI Designs: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/bf350c68368d330aab93e19e9a82e77e3b6752d4.png[/img]
Our talented UI artist, Erfan, has been hard at work to make the game more accessible and user-friendly, particularly for beginners. You'll notice clearer outcomes of tasks and the all-new leader board, this shows the history of task leaders, as well as whose team got approved and whose got rejected. Allowing the player to easily keep track of people’s suspicious choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/9927d6832c65b10de206f0c0331e9089f1b8bba9.png[/img]

[h2]2. Enhanced Visual Style[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/2a36e3b1edf38223c9328ed96b3fb6d340605a3d.png[/img]
To provide a richer and more immersive experience, we've added animated transitions to the flow of the game. Prepare to witness the visual upgrade and renaming of the Wiretap and Confide mechanics to "power plays." These changes showcase the depths the Loyalists will go to protect their president.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/9193e7e02dc69956ab35f83c54d82200c0b28ac1.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Improved Controller Layout[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/525d15eaae17494bd3ce3b937ea1b1d595f3389d.jpg[/img]
We understand the importance of quick decision-making. That's why we've been diligently working on a new controller layout. It will provide you with easy access to crucial information, ensuring you can make game-changing decisions at a glance. Please note that we're still fine-tuning the final look, so expect some minor differences in the build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/854abe49394069a92786e14aee28809c5fffa5b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Introducing the RoJ Discord App[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/3f953936d7d55114de2ff4fabbaad5a82fc4446c.png[/img]
We're excited to announce the development of the RoJ Discord App. This innovative app allows you to control the game directly within your Discord community, without the need to open a browser. It's a seamless experience for both desktop and mobile players. Community leaders can add the app to their servers, enabling groups to learn and play the game together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/c90327fa663ee87584e594acb000266f9875baea.png[/img]

[h2]5. Search for RoJ Events
[/h2]
The RoJ Discord App features a powerful search function. You can easily find in-action or planned upcoming RoJ events across our partner servers. This function allows us to promote our partner servers and shows you where and when you can join a game of RoJ. Stay tuned for a special event announcement in the near future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/320b9105dd42afc6169907ab788d43018d7251cc.jpg[/img]

We appreciate your patience and support throughout the game's development. Creating RoJ has been a monumental task, and your enthusiasm motivates us to make it the best it can be. Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam—it greatly helps us spread the word and reach more players.

Thank you, Jungle Nation, for being a part of this incredible journey. We'll be back soon with more exciting updates!

notes.title: Dev Log #4 - Thinking Outside the Fox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/fdb8563c72191bca3de09a7e1dafd9792723bb6a.png[/img]

Hello everyone, and welcome to our 4th Dev Log! Today we’re gonna talk some more about the UI rework, show off the Fiona Fox rework, touch base on some game mechanics, and more upcoming community events! Now, let’s dive into it, shall we?

[h1]UI/UX:[/h1]
Erfan, our UX designer has finalized the new character card designs, and we have started adding them to the game engine.

He also started working on the new design for “operation folders''. More info on the folders will be shown in the near future, but what we will say is that they are not only going to indicate the number of players needed in the task force, but a lot more! Here’s a first look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/72507709b66b92966222841481fb7419c6b1866f.png[/img]

There are a lot of changes we want to make to the trial phase, the end summary, and the initial loadout, so more to come on that.

[h1]Art:[/h1]
Naeem, our game artist, was primarily busy with the character redesign for Fiona Fox, who is President Puma’s antagonist and one of the 2 main characters of the game. We believe she’s coming along nicely:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/1a6e653f422283bbfec7d0226bd51a5b84063573.jpg[/img]

He’s also been busy creating the new loadout screen (the starting screen where everyone joins the game), showing off some Bite House staff striking poses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/555c64000f9d960830f285149b5270d7917d8b14.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Design:[/h1]
One of the discussions that came up a lot this past month was how we could have different achievements and recognition badges for players. Our brainstorming sessions had some excellent results, and we now have a better idea about what we can do in this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/4511ba087959227fdc37c786ff2053dab77c5848.png[/img]

With that said, there’s a lot of different challenges and scenarios that we want to add to the game to add some replayability value for the veterans. 

[h1]Tech:[/h1]
We are making great progress on the tech side. The code for the new server and the new backend API is coming along nicely, and we have already connected this new backend infrastructure to Unity.

Last but not least, a big point of focus has been the code’s testability, and we are aiming to make this new infrastructure much more testable than what we had before. This means that you as players will see much less game-breaking bugs and issues in the future, making the game experience smoother for everyone!

[h1]Community:[/h1]
We are glad to announce that our last community Game Night was yet again a blast, hosted by our dear [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shissan]Melfice[/url]! You can check out the vod [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1292016027?filter=archives&sort=time]here[/url]. More events are coming, so if you missed the opportunity to test the game before, make sure to check our socials and to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Mg7V8C9E2M]Discord[/url] so you can join us on the next Game Night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/1647ca585145a31f4464ea2b9b4b071bde91c515.jpg[/img]

That is all for this month, friends! Thanks for reading our Dev Log, and stay tuned for more! 

See you next month,

Gerdoo Games

notes.title: Our Steam Demo is live!
notes.content:
[b]After months of hard work, we're thrilled to release our PC Demo on Steam.[/b]

Today, our demo goes live as part of Steam Game Festival. It's a good showcase of what we envision for Republic of Jungle, and what we have done so far.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413250/Republic_of_Jungle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38705137/5c68be95866bd68496398653ad9c4a8b30947e83.png[/img][/url]


Some of the new things we're excited to show you:

[list]
[*] Single-player tutorial to teach the basics on your pace
[*] Interactive narrated tutorial to teach new players in the party as the game is played
[*] New character (Katie Cat) voiced by our talented voice actor (Kat!)
[*] New intro with glimpses at the world of Republic of Jungle
[*] New outro and game summary view to show you what happened
[*] Music and sound effects everywhere! (Shout out to Navid and Matheiu)
[*] New artwork, unified artstyle, animations, flavor texts, and more
[*] Our updated Steam page (with new little details for our perceptive fans!)
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of our journey. It'd help us a lot if you check out the game on Steam, wishlist the game, and/or download the demo, tell your friends, and play RoJ with them! 

Have fun,
Moein & Kasra
